disclosure.email_storage: HMAC under a server-side pepper, for sign-in lookup only

scopes.rule: The service may send sign-in challenges when the member's email is entered on the site.
The service may present proposals and certify one voting key per proposal.
The service may assign tasks and request feedback; the member signs completions.
general and message class notifications; urgent only for governance deadlines.

status_model.member: Converts in place from provisional when a subscription is paid.

revocation.member: The member may sever the connection from the phone at any time.
revocation.service: The service may revoke on membership lapse.
